title: Local cokernel presentation of a constant extension
statement: Let X be a scheme and Λ a finite ring, not necessarily commutative. Let S be a short exact sequence of sheaves of left Λ-modules on the small etale site of X [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], with constant outer terms [def-constructible-constant] having finitely generated geometric stalks [def-constructible-finite]. There exists an etale cover (U_i → X) such that, for each i, there are left Λ-modules K_i and L_i, with K_i finitely generated, a morphism φ_i between the constant sheaves (K_i)_(U_i) and (L_i)_(U_i), and an isomorphism from coker φ_i to the pullback of S.X₂ to U_i. The morphism φ_i is an arbitrary sheaf morphism, not assumed induced by a module map. No local constancy of its cokernel is asserted.

proof.text: Apply exists_constantExtension_presentation_lift to obtain an etale cover and a lifted short exact module presentation whose kernel is finitely generated. This is the finite free generator/local lifting step of Tag 093U.

On each cover member apply finite_cokernelPresentation_of_local_presentation to the short exact extension, its constant first term, and the lifted presentation. Its fully proved categorical cokernel computation gives the required finite-source presentation.

theorem exists_constantExtension_cokernelPresentation {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [Ring Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {S : ShortComplex (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))}
    (hS : S.ShortExact)
    [S.X₁.IsConstant X.smallEtaleTopology] [S.X₃.IsConstant X.smallEtaleTopology]
    [IsFiniteSheaf (FA := fun M N : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ ↦ M →ₗ[Λ] N)
      (CA := fun M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ ↦ M) S.X₁]
    [IsFiniteSheaf (FA := fun M N : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ ↦ M →ₗ[Λ] N)
      (CA := fun M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ ↦ M) S.X₃] :
    ∃ 𝒰 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage X, ∀ i,
      ∃ K L : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ, Module.Finite Λ K ∧
        ∃ φ : (constantSheaf (𝒰.X i).smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj K ⟶
          (constantSheaf (𝒰.X i).smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj L,
          Nonempty (cokernel φ ≅ (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (𝒰.f i)).obj S.X₂)
